description: Phase 3A. Exercises the WebTunnel transport family end-to-end at the soak surface: the experimental-families gate is enabled on day 1, the engine ranks bundles that include a webtunnel route alongside stable families, and the legacy 1.5C-class subscription-url block is layered on so the soak invariant ledger continues to assert the distribution-failure gates. Parse-time `bulk-capable` rejection and per-route Iranian-region caveat banner are exercised in unit tests; this scenario is the soak-level proof that an enabled gate plus a present webtunnel route does NOT regress the 30-day in-engine ledger.
